notifications.description: Whether to show notifications when firewall status changes

show_inactive.description: Whether to show inactive firewall connections in the applet

blink.description: Whether to blink the applet icon on status change

blink_count.description: Number of times to blink the icon on status change

shields_up.description: Action to take when firewall is active (e.g., block, allow)

shields_down.description: Action to take when firewall is inactive (e.g., public, private)
